name: Distortion UV Preview Shader
instruction: Create a TextureRect named DistortionPreview under Main and assign the shaderV_icon.png texture. Add a ShaderMaterial that uses a VisualShader with the DistortionUV custom node from addons/shaderV/uv/distortionUV.gd, matching the DistortionUV example constants (wave X 7, wave Y 5, distortion 0.1 on both axes).

metadata.tutorial_source: YouTube: Kextex - Rain Puddle Shader - Godot 4.0 - Visual Shader
